title: Lumen Scanner Output Schema
description:
JSON Schema for the Lumen scanner output formats.

Covers two shapes:
  1. The `ReportPayload` produced by `lumen scan` / `lumen report` (the full scored report).
  2. The hybrid upload payload sent by `lumen scan --hybrid` to lumen-api.

Downstream tooling (lumen-api, qwen-web) should use this schema to consume scanner output.

ReportPayload.title: ReportPayload
ReportPayload.description: The complete scored output written to ~/.lumen/last-scan.json and rendered as ~/lumen-report.html.

assessment_id.description: UUID assigned by the scanner (generated locally, no network).

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp of when scoring was performed.

industry.description: Industry vertical used for overlay selection, e.g. 'healthcare'. Empty string = neutral/all-1.0 overlay.

company_size.description: Company-size bucket used for question applicability.

overall_score.description: Weighted mean of all domain scores.

overall_grade.description: Letter grade for the overall score (A=90+, B=75+, C=60+, D=45+, F=<45).

scanner_used.description: Whether scanner probe findings contributed to the score.

domains.description: Per-domain scoring results, ordered by overlay weight descending.

top_risks.description: Top-3 findings sorted by contribution desc, then severity desc.

what_to_fix_first.description: Top-5 prioritised remediation steps. Items with Micelium product alignment are ordered with a 1.2× bonus.

framework_summary.description: All triggered framework references grouped by family.

plain_summary.description: One-sentence narrative of the domain result.

FindingResult.title: FindingResult
FindingResult.description: A single triggered rule and its score contribution.

triggered_by.description: Question IDs or scanner probe keys that fired this rule.

micelium_products.description: Micelium products that address this finding. Non-empty → 1.2× alignment bonus in what-to-fix-first ordering.

DomainExplain.title: DomainExplain
DomainExplain.description: Full explainability trace for the 'Why?' panel.

formula.description: Human-readable scoring formula, e.g. '100 * (1 - min(1.0, Σ contributions))'.

steps.description: Per-finding contributions, sorted by effective_contribution descending.

raw_loss.description: Sum of all contributions before capping.

ExplainStep.title: ExplainStep
ExplainStep.description: One term in the explainability trace for a domain.

Remediation.title: Remediation
Remediation.description: A prioritised fix recommendation in the 'What to Fix First' section.

FrameworkCoverage.title: FrameworkCoverage
FrameworkCoverage.description: All controls triggered for one framework family.

ScannerFindings.title: ScannerFindings
ScannerFindings.description: Structured probe outputs from the offline scanner. Used as input to the lumen-scoring engine's evalScannerCondition path. Fields match the json tags in types.ScannerFindings.

VulnerabilityFindings.title: VulnerabilityFindings
VulnerabilityFindings.description: Outputs from the vulnerabilities probe. JSON tags match ScannerFindings.Vulnerabilities field names for lumen-scoring engine reflection.

days_since_last_update.description: Days since the last OS/package update was applied. 0 if unknown.

ComplianceFindings.title: ComplianceFindings
ComplianceFindings.description: Outputs from the compliance probe. JSON tags match ScannerFindings.Compliance for lumen-scoring engine reflection.

mfa_enabled.description: Whether org-wide MFA is enforced. Always false from the scanner (cannot be determined locally); populated by questionnaire Q-COMP-MFA-001.

disk_encryption_enabled.description: Whether full-disk encryption (FileVault / LUKS / BitLocker) is active.

firewall_enabled.description: Whether the host firewall is active and configured.

screen_lock_enabled.description: Whether automatic screen lock is configured.

screen_lock_timeout_seconds.description: Idle timeout in seconds before the screen locks. 0 if screen lock is disabled or timeout is unknown.

AIGovernanceFindings.title: AIGovernanceFindings
AIGovernanceFindings.description: Outputs from the ai_governance probe. LU-5 — all fields are zero-valued in v0.1.x.

shadow_ai_apps_count.description: Number of detected local LLM or AI-assistant applications.

browser_extensions_ai_count.description: Number of detected AI-assistant browser extensions.

llm_egress_processes_count.description: Number of processes with active connections to LLM API endpoints.

mcp_servers_running.description: Count of detected Model Context Protocol server processes.

SecurityPostureFindings.title: SecurityPostureFindings
SecurityPostureFindings.description: Outputs from the security_posture probe. LU-5 — all fields are zero-valued in v0.1.x.

PrivacyFindings.title: PrivacyFindings
PrivacyFindings.description: Outputs from the privacy probe. LU-5 — all fields are zero-valued in v0.1.x.

HybridUploadPayload.title: HybridUploadPayload
HybridUploadPayload.description:
The structured findings JSON sent by `lumen scan --hybrid` to POST /api/v1/lumen/scanner/ingest.

Privacy guarantee: contains ONLY integer counts and booleans. No file content,
no PII values, no file paths, no hostnames, no usernames.

Trust model: the ed25519 signature proves payload integrity (tamper-evidence + dedup),
NOT identity. The server accepts any schema-conforming, validly-signed payload
from any install. No install-key registration server-side in v1.

scanner_version.description: Semver of the lumen binary, e.g. 'v1.0.0'.

industry.description: Industry vertical for overlay selection, e.g. 'healthcare'. May be empty string.

scanner_findings.description: Structured probe outputs from the local scanner — integer counts and booleans only.

embedded_snapshot_sha.description: The source_sha from the scanner's embedded content-snapshot.meta.json (M-7 divergence detection). A git commit hash identifying the content bundle compiled into the scanner binary. Empty string for older scanner builds that predate this field. The server compares this against its live bundle SHA; if they differ, the response includes score_divergence_warning: true. Not sensitive — this is a public git SHA.

public_key.description: Hex-encoded ed25519 public key from ~/.lumen/install.pub. Used to verify the signature.

signature.description: Hex-encoded ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of the payload body with the 'signature' field set to '' (excluded from the signed message).
